-- Obter ID da Sara Leite
SET @sara_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = 'Sara Leite' LIMIT 1);

-- Adicionar streak diário
INSERT INTO daily_streaks (user_id, current_streak, longest_streak, last_activity_date, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (@sara_id, 45, 120, CURDATE(), NOW(), NOW());
